title: odis.audit.event.v1
description: Common audit event. Mirrors APF §6.5; `event_type` accepts either the APF enum verbatim OR the `odis.<ns>.<name>` extension namespace. Runtime taxonomy enforcement (see audit_taxonomy.is_valid_event_type) is layered on top of the JSON Schema pattern.

bundle_id.description: Identifier of the Authority Grant this envelope was produced under. Carried from the loaded grant, not pinned: an envelope must name the grant actually in force.

bundle_version.description: Version of the Authority Grant in force. Carried from the loaded grant, not pinned: an envelope must name the grant actually in force.

trust_root_id.description: Trust anchor the grant's signature chains to. Carried from the loaded grant, not pinned: an envelope must name the grant actually in force.

event_type.description: APF §6.5 enum OR `odis.<ns>.<name>` extension. Runtime taxonomy check in audit_taxonomy.is_valid_event_type is the authoritative gate.

apf_semantic_enforcement.description: Sink-derived: true for resource-scoped events (the Tier 3 wedge — every forwarded/refused resource call is APF-semantically enforced). Emitters MUST NOT set this; the sink raises ConformancePostureViolation if they do.

user_id.description: Identifier of the originating principal (ODIS-CC-02). Optional in this harness; the Router does not yet authenticate an inbound principal.

extra.description: Free-form event-specific payload. Carries tool name, family, endpoint id, decision id, reason code — never provider args or secrets.
